Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 703 PM EDT Fri Oct 16 2026

- Chance of showers with gusty northwest winds this evening. 

- Turning colder late tonight with low temperatures Saturday morning
  reaching the low to mid 30s. This will lead to some areas of 
  frost. 

- Cooler conditions Saturday, then turning warmer Sunday into next 
  week. No rain expected through this time.

&&

.AVIATION...

A reinforcing cold front exiting into IN/OH leaves behind a few more 
hours of gusty north wind and churned boundary layer conditions that 
are already showing signs of dry air influence. Broken VFR ceiling 
with a stray rain shower is quickly becoming scattered as colder and 
increasingly dry air builds into Lower Mi ahead of Plains to Midwest 
surface high pressure. The dry air and backing wind direction 
deactivates the Lakes and continues the trend toward clear sky late 
tonight through Saturday morning. Clouds remain limited to just some 
cirrus streamers in the afternoon as low level dry air prevents Lake 
Michigan clouds as wind backs more toward the southwest. These 
conditions continue while the high pressure ridge slides east of 
Lower Mi by Saturday evening.  

D21/DTW Convection...No thunderstorms are forecast tonight or 
Saturday. 

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* Moderate for ceiling at or below 5,000 feet this evening. 

* Low for exceeding crosswind threshold this evening.
